# YomVezman 0.8.1 preview
App 0.8.1 (11), Apple silicon, macOS 14 or later. A reliability update within the 0.8.x feature freeze; not the 0.9.0 release candidate or an App Store-approved build.
Fixes oversized calendar downloads. Previously, the 2 MB response limit was checked only after downloading the complete body. Calendar downloads now reject an oversized declared length and enforce the limit while streaming. The offending transfer stops without canceling other calendar requests. Valid exact-request saved data remains available with its original timestamp; canceled requests do not return saved fallback.
Controlled 8 MB responses reproduced the old full-download behavior. Regression checks now cover early rejection with and without a declared length, an exact 2 MB valid body, concurrent-request survival, cancellation, and saved-data fallback. The full suite has 96 tests, including live calendar checks.
The offline Hebrew Psalms reader and other 0.8.0 features are unchanged. Spoken VoiceOver and remaining native reliability/accessibility, fresh-user/upgrade and display checks remain mandatory before **0.9.0 RC**. Native app/browser automation is unavailable in this session, so no fresh packaged UI or rendered website check is claimed. Store validation stays at **1.0.0**.
From 0.4.0 or later, use Check for Updates and follow the user-confirmed installation prompts. Older versions need one manual installation. Installation is left to the owner; no silent update is enabled.
